title: Synthetic oil-spill attribution demonstration case
disclaimer: ABYSS provides analytical evidence for investigation support. Candidate ranking does not establish legal responsibility. This dataset is synthetic: it does not describe any real vessel, voyage, spill or incident, and nothing in it asserts that any vessel caused an oil spill.

studyArea.label: Synthetic offshore study area (approximate geography used as a container for the demonstration; no real incident is referenced or implied)
studyArea.coastlineNote: Coarse synthetic polyline used only for land/sea plausibility context. It is not survey data and must not be used for navigation.

aisExtract.label: AIS: Synthetic Demonstration Dataset
notes: Positions outside the bounding box are intentionally absent, so some vessels begin or end mid-track; that is ordinary behaviour for an area-scoped extract
Records are ordered by timestamp; malformed-timestamp fixture rows keep their intended position in that ordering
Every row carries datasetLabel='Synthetic Demonstration Dataset'
No cleaning, filtering or scoring has been applied to these records

sensor.name: synthetic demonstration SAR scene
sensor.band: C-band SAR-like (demonstration stand-in, not a real acquisition)

observation.sceneDescription: Bundled demonstration scene: detection is modelled on the pre-computed slick polygon delivered with the case, so the demo runs with no imagery download.

origin.uncertaintyShape: ellipse (prototype representation of an uncertainty region)
notes: The release window and origin region are INPUTS of this case used to build the scenario; the product must reconstruct them from the slick and environmental data, and must report them as estimates with uncertainty
No single-point origin is published anywhere in the case configuration

reservedOriginFixtureNote: Answer key for automated tests only. It is NOT an input to the analysis pipeline and must never be surfaced by the API, the dashboard or a report.

vessels.name: DEMO MERIDIAN STAR
vessels.roleDescription: Inside the probable-origin uncertainty region during the release window with a compatible trajectory and a marked slowdown nearby. Expected highest compatibility.
vessels.syntheticIdentityNote: Synthetic identity for the demonstration dataset. It is not asserted to correspond to any real vessel or voyage.

vessels.name: DEMO CORAL VOYAGER
vessels.roleDescription: Inside the origin region when a 4 h AIS gap starts; the gap crosses the region and its endpoints are reachable at a plausible 10.5 kn. Expected high compatibility.
vessels.syntheticIdentityNote: Synthetic identity for the demonstration dataset. It is not asserted to correspond to any real vessel or voyage.

vessels.name: DEMO IRON HORIZON
vessels.roleDescription: Inside the origin region when a 4 h AIS gap starts, but reappears ~260 km away - an implied ~35 kn. The gap is physically impossible and must not raise suspicion.
vessels.syntheticIdentityNote: Synthetic identity for the demonstration dataset. It is not asserted to correspond to any real vessel or voyage.

vessels.name: DEMO HARBOUR LIGHT
vessels.roleDescription: Closest vessel to the OBSERVED slick at observation time, but far from the probable ORIGIN during the release window. Distractor for proximity-based reasoning.
vessels.syntheticIdentityNote: Synthetic identity for the demonstration dataset. It is not asserted to correspond to any real vessel or voyage.

vessels.name: DEMO SILVER TIDE
vessels.roleDescription: Crosses the probable-origin region hours AFTER the release window closes. Correct place, wrong time: expected low temporal compatibility.
vessels.syntheticIdentityNote: Synthetic identity for the demonstration dataset. It is not asserted to correspond to any real vessel or voyage.

vessels.name: DEMO FROST PELICAN
vessels.roleDescription: Strong behavioural anomaly (speed swings and 90 degree course changes) ~200 km from the origin region. Anomaly alone must not produce a high rank.
vessels.syntheticIdentityNote: Synthetic identity for the demonstration dataset. It is not asserted to correspond to any real vessel or voyage.

vessels.name: DEMO NORTHERN GATE
vessels.roleDescription: Legitimate steady transit ~90 km from the origin region: no anomaly, no gap. Shows that a normal vessel in the same area and time window is not promoted.
vessels.syntheticIdentityNote: Synthetic identity for the demonstration dataset. It is not asserted to correspond to any real vessel or voyage.

vessels.name: DEMO SEA LARK
vessels.roleDescription: Many slow and stationary periods and an irregular track, but ~170 km from the origin region. Legitimate working pattern that must not be flagged as suspicious.
vessels.syntheticIdentityNote: Synthetic identity for the demonstration dataset. It is not asserted to correspond to any real vessel or voyage.

vessels.name: DEMO SKY BRIDGE
vessels.roleDescription: Fast, steady, predictable shuttle service well north of the origin region. High speed and the 180 degree turnarounds must not be read as suspicious behaviour.
vessels.syntheticIdentityNote: Synthetic identity for the demonstration dataset. It is not asserted to correspond to any real vessel or voyage.

vessels.name: DEMO COASTAL WREN
vessels.roleDescription: Slow coastal transit whose track stays offshore and roughly parallel to the coastline - used to test land/sea plausibility rather than suspicion.
vessels.syntheticIdentityNote: Synthetic identity for the demonstration dataset. It is not asserted to correspond to any real vessel or voyage.

vessels.name: DEMO ANCHOR TUG
vessels.roleDescription: Local harbour movements with long mooring periods ~115 km from the origin region. Stationary periods must not be weighted as suspicious.
vessels.syntheticIdentityNote: Synthetic identity for the demonstration dataset. It is not asserted to correspond to any real vessel or voyage.

vessels.name: DEMO FAR CURRENT
vessels.roleDescription: Distant steady transit that should be filtered out early. Included so the ranking is not distorted by irrelevant traffic.
vessels.syntheticIdentityNote: Synthetic identity for the demonstration dataset. It is not asserted to correspond to any real vessel or voyage.
